verdict.rationale: No first-party pricing documentation is in the pack. Community reports point to a per-unit model: one user cites Algolia's "price-per-search model" and another hit record limits, which implies usage-based pricing on searches and records. Prediction has a caveat, though: every sort option needs a duplicate index, which turned one user's 30K records into 150K. missing for 10: first-party published pricing page or rate card, documented per-search/per-record unit prices, cost-estimation tooling or calculator, clear guidance on how replicas count toward billable records.
